description: Per-cell accessibility outputs backing Table 1, Figure 2, and Supplementary S1/S3's default-beam accuracy analyses: LinearRaccess (beam=100), Raccess Exact (max_span=sequence length), and Raccess Window (max_span=100), all run under the raccess-compatibility engine and Turner 1999 parameters so LinearRaccess and Raccess agree on the reference energy model, on 12,872 bpRNA-1m(90) sequences (100-1,000 nt).

layout.linear_b200/<seq_id>.txt: LinearRaccess (beam=200) raw per-cell probabilities, used by Supplementary S1's failure-subset re-check
layout.<seq_id>_summary.json: per-sequence run metadata (status, exit code, peak memory) -- no accessibility values
layout.diagnostics/: exploratory plots from earlier analysis passes, not cited by the manuscript
layout.summary.json: aggregate per-bin/pooled median absolute error for Table 1 (computed by benchmark/scripts/compute_bprna_accuracy_summary.py from the raw per-cell files above)

note: The raw per-cell files (exact/, linear_b100/, linear_b200/, window_w100/) are gitignored (regenerable from the pinned software revisions above); only summary.json and this provenance.json are tracked. Figure 2's scatter plot and Supplementary S1's split/failure-subset statistics read the raw per-cell files directly and therefore require regenerating this bundle locally, unlike Table 1, which is fully supported by the tracked summary.json.
